title: Choosing Fairness Over Family Loyalty
paragraphs: Serving on a small community committee, Harith faced a difficult decision when his own cousin applied for a position that a more qualified outside candidate had also applied for that same week.

Despite pressure from family members expecting him to favor his relative, Harith recommended the more qualified candidate, explaining honestly to his cousin why fairness mattered more than family connection in this decision.
His cousin was initially upset, and a few relatives criticized Harith at a family gathering, questioning why he would not use his position to help someone from his own family.

Months later, watching the more qualified candidate perform excellently in the role, several relatives who had once criticized Harith privately admitted his difficult decision had ultimately been the right one.
